summary: The installer inventory file (ini or yaml) defines hosts and groups; its location depends on the installer (RPM `/opt/ansible-automation-platform/installer`, or the extracted bundle or non-bundle directory), and `ansible all -i <inventory> --list-hosts` verifies the hosts.
questions: Where is the AAP installer inventory file?
How do I check the hosts in my installer inventory?
Can the installer inventory be YAML?
